The '''19th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2008 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2007, were held at [[The Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]], on February 2, 2008.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Siegel|first1=Tatiana|title=‘No Country’ tops PGA
